**0.5h**

I first created the kicad project, then I looked up the schematic of the RP Nano, I then added a usb C port the RP2040 IC and the CC1101 RF IC. I added 5.1k pull-down resistors to the cc0/1 pins of the usb c port, and i connected the Data lines from the port to the MCU.
